stories.title: Discovered Materials is playing AI whack-a-mole to hunt cooler chips
stories.summary: A startup is using AI to hunt for new materials that could make computer chips cooler and more efficient. Discovered Materials just raised $9 million to speed up the search for next-gen tech.
stories.extended_summary: AI is solving a problem it helped create: Discovered Materials is deploying swarms of AI agents to find new materials for more efficient integrated circuits. The startup, which just raised $9 million, uses AI to generate thousands of material leads daily, a process that used to take a PhD student weeks. This could lead to cooler, more energy-efficient chips, tackling the heat problem in data centers head-on.

stories.title: ‘Nobody Wanted to Give A Former Principal Money’: How An Educator Built An Edtech AI Startup With $63M From VCs
stories.summary: Former principal Adeel Khan turned his ChatGPT experiments into a $63M edtech startup. Despite early rejections, he's now helping teachers everywhere harness AI.
stories.extended_summary: Adeel Khan, a former principal, took a sabbatical in 2022 and stumbled upon ChatGPT. After testing it with teachers, he saw a divide: some were transformed, others indifferent. Determined to make AI accessible to all educators, he founded an edtech startup that has raised $63M from VCs. Khan's journey from 'nobody wanted to give a former principal money' to leading a venture-backed company is a testament to the power of innovative thinking in education.
